completedItems: Preserved the pre-existing dirty worktree and ignored runtime/customer data without destructive cleanup, broad staging, push, publication, or live Canada Post action.

Implemented allowlisted clean release staging, repository-native redacting secret scanning, prohibited-content detection, source/package manifests, SHA-256 checksums, extract-and-rescan verification, SBOM and dependency licence output.

Implemented authoritative versioned policy and holiday data from official Canada Post sources, first-attempt logic, peak thresholds, service mapping, conservative exclusions, deadlines and deterministic schema-validated evidence.
Implemented bilingual deterministic tracking-event normalization with raw evidence hashes, conflicts, timezone handling, unknowns and explicit first-attempt failure states.

Migrated SQLite through schema version 6 with immutable classifications/tracking evidence, manual reviews, audit history, queue snapshots, worker revalidation, structured claim details and append-only integer-minor-unit financial entries.
Implemented reviewed queue snapshots and immediate per-claim policy revalidation that blocks stale, expired, changed, ambiguous, duplicate or incomplete claims before an attempt.
Replaced PHP Steps 1 and 2 with Node EST/REST XML implementations, protected credential stdin and synthetic parity/security fixtures; PHP is no longer required.

Fixed packaged worker launch ENOTDIR by centralizing named Node-worker resolution, using Electron with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE, validating a private userData worker cwd, packaging every worker outside ASAR, waiting for the spawn event before Step 1 reports started, and passing a packaged synthetic EST smoke test.
Added Linux AppImage and Windows NSIS configuration, deterministic bundled Playwright Chromium, Linux/Windows CI, clean staging, package auditing and beta/stable/signing-ready configuration.
Added a deterministic loopback mock portal, fault-injection points and crash/duplicate/reconciliation safety tests without production calls.
Migrated BrowserView to WebContentsView, sandboxed both renderers, blocked arbitrary navigation/windows/downloads/permissions, narrowed IPC and added browser session/profile controls.
Implemented versioned scrypt/AES-256-GCM backups with authenticated metadata, archive resource/path limits, atomic file creation, integrity checks, rollback copies and legacy warnings.
Added first-run readiness, deadline/search/date/service/urgency queue controls, separate manual/ineligible queues, English/Canadian French resources, accessibility controls and checks.

Added currency-aware recovery reporting, disabled-by-default local redacted crash reports, signed update metadata verification, privacy/security/support/lifecycle/legal/pilot documentation and manual release gates.
Corrected EST legacy-response parity and structured empty-result handling so a valid zero-order export completes without replacing tracking.csv or appearing as failed.

Corrected Step 2 to use the documented Developer Program Tracking REST v2 Basic-authentication contract, safe XML fault diagnostics, a three-identical-systemic-failure circuit breaker, queue preservation and an explicitly confirmed one-request diagnostic mode.
Rebuilt and headlessly extracted the final AppImage; its empty/populated Step 1 and success/systemic-500 Step 2 synthetic worker smokes all passed without launching the GUI or contacting Canada Post.

Constrained Steps 1–3 live logs to independent viewport-bounded 2,000-entry scroll regions with paused auto-follow, unread counts and Jump to latest; Step 1 visible per-shipment lines were replaced by aggregate progress while sanitized disk detail remains complete.

Separated website/EST and Developer Program API credentials, added production/development mapping and metadata/mismatch checks, manually rejected all redirects, classified safe HTML failure types, corrected circuit-abort semantics and exposed an exactly-one-request no-state-change diagnostic.

Passed the complete source validation matrix and rebuilt/extracted AppImage smokes for 10,000-row Step 1 plus Step 2 redirect, HTML login, one-request success and circuit failure without GUI launch or production calls.

Migrated the public-beta Step 2 path to the current Developer Portal OAuth 2.0 and JSON Tracking contract, isolated the legacy Basic/XML client with no fallback, added encrypted current client credentials, memory-only token caching/refresh, JSON schema normalization and a credential/environment/version diagnostic gate.

Pinned the official Tracking OpenAPI derivative (contract 1.0.0 on the portal 2.0.0 generation), exact production/test gateways, exact token/tracking routes, merchant scope and IBM client headers; classified HTML-bodied HTTP 504 primarily as a gateway timeout.
Applied the patched brace-expansion 5.0.8 build-tool override and passed both full and production npm audits with zero vulnerabilities.
Rebuilt the Linux beta AppImage and passed package audit plus packaged token success/failure, Tracking JSON success, 401 refresh, 504 circuit and one-request state-integrity smokes.

Corrected live Tracking normalization for the official direct JSON object, API-first service fields, validated EST fallback, routine lifecycle events, English/French first-attempt evidence, revised expected delivery and separate actual delivery.

Added a value-free one-shipment structural export, parser-version semantic diagnostic gate, initial-sample semantic circuit breaker, run-scoped staging, atomic database promotion, incomplete-run discard/reversion and fail-closed Step 3 authority checks.

Replaced the obsolete 3.1-second delay with a concurrency-one adaptive limiter using a 500 ms default, 250 ms floor, 0–100 ms jitter, exact Retry-After, a 60-second headerless-429 minimum, bounded gateway backoff and cancellation-safe waits.

Fixed the packaged SQLite startup failure by reconciling actual schema objects in dependency order, creating classification_records before its run_id/index/trigger/dependent operations, wrapping every change and schema-version promotion in one transaction, creating and verifying runtime pre-migration backups, validating integrity and foreign keys, and guarding Electron startup with a controlled recovery dialog.

Added a production-bootstrap isolated userData override guarded by an exact two-variable confirmation, canonical ownership/permission/symlink/default/repository/AppImage validation, centralized mutable-path containment, a persistent isolated-data banner/title and main-process claim/browser/update/export/restore blocks.

Passed source, unpacked-package and extracted-final-AppImage isolated-profile smokes: one verified schema-7 migration backup, row preservation, second-startup no-op with no second backup, byte-identical synthetic default profile and fail-closed path rejection without a GUI launch.

Traced the Step 2 diagnostic/bulk divergence to a missing EST Shipment Date after confirming bulk retained event 1442 and both delivery timestamps; introduced canonical normalized-shipment/classification-input schemas and shared deterministic classification construction through diagnostics, staging, policy, persistence, queue reconstruction and revalidation.

Fixed active-environment OAuth cache identity/logging, added bounded cancellable Tracking resource timeout retries without unnecessary token refresh, stopped semantic/policy invariant failures without promotion, and passed unpacked plus extracted-AppImage parity/event-1442/timeout/invariant smokes.

Confirmed aggregate-only that the existing 284-row tracking CSV has present-but-blank Shipment Date and Service Code columns throughout; implemented est-import-v4 Manifest/Mailing Date joining, versioned MATNR article mapping, provenance, structural diagnostics, fail-before-write quality gates, exact invariant codes, and local pre-network Step 2 date rejection without modifying the operator file.

Complete all external and human validation listed in MANUAL_RELEASE_GATES.md.
